ownerFieldNote.body: New Jersey's statewide parcel composite documents an OWNER_NAME column for Bergen County, but it is not populated on the public web service: on 2026-10-04 none of the 281,646 Bergen rows carried a value, so no query can retrieve ownership here. The NJ Office of GIS states in the service description that the OWNER_NAME field is redacted per Daniel's Law for public web access. counties.notes: Bergen County, New Jersey is served from the NJ Office of GIS statewide Parcels and MOD-IV composite, Parcels_Composite_NJ_WM FeatureServer layer 0 (Cad_parcel_mod4), the same layer Essex County uses. Filter with COUNTY='BERGEN': 281,646 of the layer's 3,481,240 rows on 2026-10-04. OWNER_NAME is an empty string on every row statewide: COUNTY='BERGEN' AND OWNER_NAME<>'' returns 0, while the control COUNTY='BERGEN' AND ST_ADDRESS<>'' returns all 281,646. Test it with <>'' because IS NOT NULL passes on the blank strings. The column is deliberately not listed as a search field, because the owner classifier takes the first owner-looking field and would route owner lookups to a blank column. The service description says the field is redacted per Daniel's Law for public web access. Searchable: PAMS_PIN (municipality code, block and lot, e.g. 0201_404_2), COUNTY, MUN_NAME, PROP_LOC (property location), and ST_ADDRESS, the mailing street on the tax record, with CITY_STATE and ZIP_CODE alongside. On 2026-10-04 ST_ADDRESS and CITY_STATE were filled on all 281,646 Bergen rows and ZIP_CODE on 281,612. The mailing street matches the property location exactly on 139,563 rows; the rest differ, some only in spelling (140 MALLISON ST. against 140 MALLINSON ST), and 1,911 begin PO BOX. CITY_STATE is free text, so HACKENSACK, NJ and HACKENSACK NJ both occur. Property class, land, improvement and net values, acreage, the last sale, year built (filled on 263,852 rows) and building description (241,129) come from MOD-IV; the layer also carries deed book, page and date. CORS is open (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *), maxRecordCount is 2000 and the layer is Web Mercator. The item's licence text is a disclaimer that requests acknowledgement of NJOGIS and points to the State's conditions of use. Ownership is available from the municipal tax assessor. Verified live 2026-10-04: COUNTY='BERGEN' AND MUN_NAME LIKE '%HACKENSACK%' returned rows (first PAMS_PIN 0223_36.03_13, 95 FREDERICK ST., Hackensack City).

basis.note: Mailing addresses are published for most parcels, but New Jersey's Daniel's Law lets protected individuals such as judges, law enforcement and domestic-violence victims suppress their address, so affected rows return null or redacted values.

counties.notes: Monmouth County (pop. 643,000; Jersey Shore and inland suburbs) uses a county-direct FeatureServer separate from the NJOGIS statewide layer, whose OWNER_NAME is blank for every Monmouth row. As of 2026-10-03 the county publishes from a new ArcGIS Online org (MonmouthNJGIS): Monmouth_County_Parcels, layer 0 (Parcels) at services1.arcgis.com, item modified 2026-09-25, CORS open, about 265,000 rows. The older services9.arcgis.com GEO_MC_Parcels service now answers Invalid URL and is gone from that org's service list, and the services6.arcgis.com monmouth_county_nj_parcels copy the item search still lists is unshared (Token Required); neither should be re-registered. The layer is Monmouth County GIS's own MOD-IV data pull. PAMSPIN is the statewide identifier, structured as county code + municipality code + block + lot + qualifier code (QCODE). Owner_Name is public and queryable. Assessment fields include Net_Value, Land_Value, Impr_Value, Sale_Date, Sale_Price, and Year_Built; every one of them is a STRING on this layer (Sale_Date reads like 12/09/99), so numeric compares and sorts will not behave. Owner mailing address is split into Owner_Street and Owner_Csz, a single padded city/state/ZIP string; the separate City/State/Zip columns appear to hold a situs postal city and are not declared as mailing fields. The old Acreage field has no reliable twin (Lot_Size read 0.0000 on a sampled row) and was dropped. The layer carries Duplicate and Error flag columns and has more rows than the state composite (265,259 vs 249,796), so duplicate parcels exist and pickers should expect tied rows. The MUN and MUN_NAME fields identify the 53-municipality breakdown within the county (e.g., Freehold Borough, Long Branch, Red Bank, Asbury Park). Note: NJ Daniel's Law (P.L. 2021, c.371) allows protected individuals -- judges, law enforcement, domestic-violence victims -- to suppress their address from public records; the county layer may return null or redacted values for mailing addresses on affected parcels. For unredacted deed and transfer records, the Monmouth County Clerk's office portal at mcgifts.co.monmouth.nj.us is the authoritative source.
